title: Toasts and Alerts
description:
## **Toast** 

→ [NUXT UI 3.3](https://ui.nuxt.com/components/toast#usage)

### The Toast component provides non-intrusive, transient notifications to inform users about system events, errors, or user actions (e.g. success messages, warnings, or alerts). It should be simple to trigger, customizable, and stackable.

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=1-40](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=1-40)

## Alert Dialog

### <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User story

**As a** user,  
**I want** to see a clear and interruptive dialog when I'm about to perform an irreversible or destructive action (e.g. delete a file), **So that** I can confirm or cancel the action and avoid accidental data loss.

---

The Alert Dialog component provides a modal overlay that prompts the user to confirm or cancel critical or destructive actions. It should clearly communicate the consequence of the action, require intentional confirmation, and block interaction with the underlying interface until resolved.

enrichedData.purpose: Provides non-intrusive toast notifications for system events and user actions, plus interruptive alert dialogs for confirming critical or destructive actions before execution.
useCases: Display toast notifications for success, warning, error, and neutral states
Trigger toasts via API or component usage
Manually dismiss toasts via close button
Stack multiple toasts simultaneously with optional queue limit
Show progress bar indicating time remaining until auto-dismiss
Display variant-specific icons (checkmark for success, etc.)
Support rich content including HTML and component slots
Adapt toast position and spacing for mobile screens
Prompt user confirmation before irreversible or destructive actions via alert dialog
Block background interaction with modal overlay and backdrop
Support primary, secondary, and cancel actions with customizable button styles
Apply danger styling for destructive actions and positive styling for confirmations
Show loading state on confirm button for async operations
Trap focus within alert dialog for accessibility
Support keyboard navigation with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, and Escape
Dismiss alert dialog via Escape key or overlay click (configurable)
